# University of Alberta
> A leading Canadian research university in Edmonton offering undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education programs across diverse disciplines.

The University of Alberta serves prospective students, current learners, researchers, and partners through admissions resources, program directories, graduate studies, continuing education, experiential learning, research, and campus services.

## Main University
- [University of Alberta Home](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/index.html): Main university homepage with institutional overview, news, and key pathways.
- [Admissions + Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/index.html): Central entry point for undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education options.
- [Experiential Learning](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/experiential-learning/index.html): Overview of work-integrated, community-engaged, and hands-on learning opportunities.
- [Campuses](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/about/campuses/index.html): Information about the university’s campuses, locations, and facilities.
- [About the University](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/about/index.html): Institutional profile, leadership, strategy, and university facts.
- [News](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/news/index.html): University news, research stories, announcements, and expert commentary.

## Undergraduate Admissions
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/index.html): Undergraduate admissions hub with application guidance and student pathways.
- [How to Apply](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/how-to-apply/index.html): Step-by-step undergraduate application process and requirements.
- [Admission Requirements](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/how-to-apply/admission-requirements/index.html): Academic and subject requirements for undergraduate applicants.
- [Dates + Deadlines](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/how-to-apply/dates-deadlines/index.html): Key undergraduate application, document, and decision deadlines.
- [International Undergraduate Admission](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/international-undergraduate-admission.html): Admissions information for international undergraduate applicants.
- [Tuition + Scholarships](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/tuition-and-scholarships/index.html): Undergraduate tuition, scholarships, awards, and financial support information.
- [Apply Now](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/how-to-apply/index.html): Application entry point for prospective undergraduate students.

## Undergraduate Programs
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/index.html): Searchable directory of undergraduate degrees and program options.
- [Programs by Faculty](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/programs-by-faculty.html): Undergraduate programs organized by faculty and academic unit.
- [Programs by Name](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/programs-by-name.html): Alphabetical listing of undergraduate programs and majors.
- [Programs by Interest](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/undergraduate-programs/programs-by-interest.html): Undergraduate programs grouped by academic and career interests.
- [Open Studies](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/open-studies/index.html): Flexible undergraduate course-taking option without full program admission.

## Graduate Studies
- [Faculty of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/index.html): Graduate studies hub for admissions, policies, funding, and student support.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-programs/index.html): Directory of master’s, doctoral, and graduate diploma programs.
- [Apply to Graduate Studies](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/admissions-programs/apply/index.html): Graduate application process, requirements, and submission guidance.
- [Tuition Fees](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/fees-funding/tuition-fees/index.html): Graduate tuition and fee information by program and student type.
- [Fees + Funding](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/fees-funding/index.html): Graduate funding, awards, tuition, and financial planning resources.
- [Graduate Admissions + Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/admissions-programs/index.html): Admissions and program information for prospective graduate students.
- [Current Graduate Students](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/current-students/index.html): Policies, milestones, forms, and support for enrolled graduate students.

## Continuing Education
- [Continuing Education Home](https://coned.ualberta.ca/): Professional development, certificates, and lifelong learning offerings.
- [Programs + Courses](https://coned.ualberta.ca/program-courses/index.jsp): Searchable catalog of continuing education programs and courses.
- [Courses](https://coned.ualberta.ca/program-courses/index.jsp#sort=relevancy&f:@ua__oce_type=[Course]): Continuing education course listings across subject areas and formats.
- [Programs](https://coned.ualberta.ca/program-courses/index.jsp#sort=relevancy&f:@ua__oce_type=[Program]): Continuing education certificates, programs, and credential pathways.
- [Organizational Training](https://coned.ualberta.ca/organizational-services.jsp): Customized training and workforce development for organizations and teams.
- [Funding Assistance](https://coned.ualberta.ca/resources/funding-assistance/index.jsp): Financial assistance and funding resources for continuing education learners.
- [Online Learning](https://coned.ualberta.ca/online-learning.jsp): Information about online continuing education delivery and learning formats.

## Tuition, Awards, and Financial Support
- [Undergraduate Tuition + Scholarships](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/tuition-and-scholarships/index.html): Undergraduate costs, scholarships, awards, and financial support options.
- [Graduate Tuition Fees](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/fees-funding/tuition-fees/index.html): Tuition details for graduate students by program and status.
- [Graduate Fees + Funding](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/fees-funding/index.html): Graduate awards, assistantships, and funding guidance.
- [Continuing Education Funding Assistance](https://coned.ualberta.ca/resources/funding-assistance/index.jsp): Funding and support options for continuing education students.
- [Student Financial Support](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/registrar/scholarships-awards-financial-support/index.html): Central resource for scholarships, awards, and financial aid services.

## Research
- [Research at the U of A](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/research/index.html): Research strengths, institutes, supports, and innovation initiatives.
- [Research Services Office](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/research/services/index.html): Administrative and compliance support for research activity.
- [Innovation + Partnerships](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/research/innovation/index.html): Commercialization, industry collaboration, and innovation support resources.
- [Research Institutes + Centres](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/research/research-institutes-centres/index.html): Directory of research institutes, centres, and specialized facilities.
- [Undergraduate Research](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/current-students/undergraduate-research-initiative/index.html): Opportunities and support for undergraduate research participation.

## Student Life and Support
- [Current Students](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/current-students/index.html): Central hub for academic, administrative, and campus life resources.
- [Registrar](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/registrar/index.html): Registration, records, calendars, and student administrative services.
- [Academic Calendar](https://calendar.ualberta.ca/): Official academic calendar with regulations, programs, and course information.
- [Residence Services](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/residence/index.html): On-campus housing options, applications, and residence life information.
- [Student Services](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/services/index.html): Campus services including advising, wellness, and student support.
- [International Services Centre](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/international/international-student-services/index.html): Support for international students before and during studies.

## Faculties and Colleges
- [Faculties + Colleges](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/faculties/index.html): Directory of faculties, colleges, and academic units.
- [College of Health Sciences](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/health-sciences/index.html): Health sciences colleges, programs, and collaborative initiatives.
- [Faculty of Arts](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/arts/index.html): Programs, departments, and student resources in the arts.
- [Faculty of Science](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/science/index.html): Science programs, research, and student opportunities.
- [Faculty of Engineering](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/engineering/index.html): Engineering programs, research, and experiential learning opportunities.
- [Alberta School of Business](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/business/index.html): Business degrees, research, and student services.
- [Faculty of Education](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/education/index.html): Teacher education, graduate study, and educational research programs.

## News and Events
- [News](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/news/index.html): University-wide news, stories, and media releases.
- [Events](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/events/index.html): Public lectures, academic events, and campus activities.
- [Folio](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/folio/index.html): Feature stories and in-depth coverage of university people and ideas.
- [Media Relations](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/media-relations/index.html): Media contacts, expert sources, and institutional communications.
